prompt: Flat 2D fantasy video game boss art: one colossal cosmic sovereign seen from the front from the waist up. Its head is a perfect, featureless, pitch-black eclipse disc ringed by a thin white-hot rim and a crown of ember orange, gold and white flame streamers. Its broad torso and shoulders are heavy black-gold plate armour engraved with gold lines. Around its body turns a vast mechanical orrery: three solid metal armillary rings, wide flat bands of black iron with engraved gold edges and gold rivets, tilted at different angles, passing in front of and behind the torso. Four solid round planets of four different colours ride the metal rings: one icy frost cyan planet, one ember orange planet, one dark deep teal planet and one pale storm white planet. Its two colossal armoured gauntlets with gold claws rest at the lower left and lower right corners. Plain flat grey background, nothing else. Crisp hard edges, flat cel shading with few tones, high contrast, light from the upper left.
